notes.46r.16: 46r.17: 'and so on' (oc cetera) is the manuscript's own; the age limit is not written out. 46r.21: þæiꝛi is unclear; read as a number of households (perhaps 'three'), set against the single household of the next clause. 'heraƶ ꝼlytt' is read as 'made known in the district'; uncertain.
notes.42v.10: 42v.12 lacks its initial (Þat). The passage does not say how many oath-helpers the lýrittareiðr required.
